docBrowserSearchPlaceholder: Search, or enter a doc URL to open
sideDockHideConfirmDescription: You can turn it back on from Settings > Appearance.
sideDockVisibilityDescription: Keep the right shortcut dock visible beside the workspace.
appPackagesLibraryDescription: Open and manage the apps in NextClaw. Installs continue in the background, and personal data stays local.
appPackagesMarketplaceDescription: Choose apps that fit the way you use NextClaw. You can keep browsing or leave while an install continues.
appPackagesMarketplaceFailed: The app marketplace is temporarily unavailable. You can still install from a trusted source.
appPackagesMarketplaceEmptyHint: Try a shorter search or switch back to All.
appPackagesMarketplaceTrustHint: Apps come from the official NextClaw library. Review access before installing, then disable or uninstall at any time.
appPackagesInstallDescription: Enter a trusted .napp file path, local app directory, or app ID.
appPackagesInstallTrustHint: Only install sources you trust. Apps with a Service can run local code, and start only after you enable them.
appPackagesEmptyDescription: Install a Mini APP, or upgrade to a NextClaw version that includes built-in apps.
appPackagesEnableToOpen: Enable this app to open it
appPackagesUninstallDescription: The app code will be removed. Personal data is kept by default so a future reinstall can continue using it.
appPackagesKeepDataDescription: Remove only the app code so a future reinstall can continue with existing content.
appPackagesDeleteDataDescription: Permanently remove data saved by this app. This cannot be undone.
appPackagesDocumentAccess: Needs access to {count} file folder(s) you approve
appPackagesNetworkAccess: Needs to connect to {count} network domain(s)
appPackagesHostBridgeAccess: Uses local capabilities provided by NextClaw
appPackagesLocalStorageAccess: Stores its own app data on this device
appPackagesNoExtraAccess: No additional file or network access declared
panelAppsEmptyDescription: Panel apps are lightweight tools that open beside chat, such as dashboards, forms, calculators, and temporary workbenches.
panelAppsEmptyAskDescription: Start with a ready-made prompt that creates a sample local tool for this panel.
panelAppsExamplePrompt: Create a sample NextClaw Panel App for me: a personal task board. Put it in the NextClaw panels folder as a single *.panel.html file. Include adding tasks, toggling completion, filtering, and local state persistence. After creating it, tell me to refresh Panel Apps and open it. Do not ask follow-up questions first.
panelAppsEmptyFileTitle: Add it to the panels folder
panelAppsEmptyFileDescription: You can also add a *.panel.html file, or a *.panel folder with panel-app.json.
panelAppsEmptyFiltered: No panel apps in this view
panelAppsDeleteConfirmDescription: This will delete the panel app file and cannot be undone.
panelAppsClientGrantDescription: Allow this panel app to use the full NextClaw Client SDK.
serviceAppsEmptyDescription: Service apps expose local runtimes and actions that panel apps can call.
serviceAppsDiscoverActionsHint: Connect to the service app runtime and discover its available actions.
serviceAppsDisconnectRuntimeHint: Close the current runtime connection and return the service app to not connected.
serviceAppsDeleteConfirmDescription: This will delete the service app directory and cannot be undone.
serviceAppsStatusHint_idle: The runtime is not connected yet; connecting and discovering actions will start it.
serviceAppsStatusHint_starting: Connecting to the service app runtime.
serviceAppsStatusHint_running: The service app runtime is connected and ready for action discovery or invocation.
serviceAppsStatusHint_failed: The runtime connection failed; check the error or disconnect and try again.
serviceActionAuthorizationDescription: This panel app is requesting local service actions. If allowed, these actions will stay granted for this panel app.
